description:
The LIPIcs proceedings class, lipics-v2021 (v3.1.3, 2023/05/12); its layout is fixed. Not on the engine's mirror or CTAN: the class and its two logos are from Dagstuhl Publishing's styles repository (github.com/dagstuhl-publishing/styles, LIPIcs/authors). Its orcid.pdf is left out, as another class's file has that name; the class falls back without it. lipics sets hyperref's PDF title from \@title at  egin{document} (lipics-v2021.cls l.663-692). General's title ends its \parbox with \par, which no PDF string takes (beamer.A, batch 3b: 19 of 19 such documents stopped at \HyPsd@@ProtectSpacesFi). So PDF strings read \par as a space, which hyperref allows since its pre-hook runs before it makes \space unexpandable (hyperref.dtx l.1500, l.1507); the pages are unchanged. lipics counts its authors in \c@author, made with 
ewcount (lipics-v2021.cls l.762), and biblatex makes a counter for each name list with 
ewcounter (biblatex.sty l.7679-7685: 
ewcounter{author}), so every document with General's biblatex bibliography or a library biblatex way stopped at 'Command \c@author already defined' (GitHub run 41584963423: 539 lipics.A documents hold it, the first failure of 11,260 not-denied branches, result fdf5a28b58d2 l.7685). The second preamble line clears \c@author just before biblatex loads and copies lipics's count into biblatex's new counter after it, so both read one register, as they did once LaTeX ignored the failed 
ewcounter; it does nothing where biblatex is not loaded.
